llm.summary: The skill retrieves football data through a clearly disclosed, narrowly scoped API helper, with no material security concern found in the inspected files.

dimensions.detail: Bash, curl, network access, and a user-supplied Crawlora key fit the workflow. The helper permits only GET requests to eight fixed routes and blocks query arguments that could read local files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains documentation and a Bash helper, with no installer, dependency download, or remote code execution. Metadata provides no publisher identity.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Analysis defaults to one verified match, requires asking before broad collection or repeated snapshots, and limits optional report context to user requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The key is placed in a private temporary curl configuration with exit cleanup. No credential-store access, background workers, privilege escalation, or persistent agent changes appear.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The eight permitted sports-data endpoints support match reporting; optional historical and odds context is explicitly documented.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Match queries and your service key go to Crawlora, and requests can consume credits. Use a dedicated API key, keep private information out of searches, and treat optional odds as snapshots rather than predictions.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The advisory concern is not substantiated by missing tool declarations alone: shell use is disclosed, and the inspected helper restricts its destination, methods, and routes.
[E1] expected: All three URL signals concern the disclosed provider. The helper sends supplied query parameters and the Crawlora key to its fixed API host; no unrelated file upload or destination appears. The [provider site](https://crawlora.net/) describes API-key-based web-data access consistent with this integration.
[SDI-2] expected: The stated mismatch is contradicted by SKILL.md, which explicitly documents optional odds context, labels it as a snapshot, and limits its inclusion to requests. The helper provides no betting transaction capability.
